The intent of this tool is to demonstrate what is possible by using NaC-API. NaC API is a north bound API gateway to Source Code Managers. This allows you to interact with a source code repository (GIT) via API instead of human direct interaction.

This provides the ability to have automated workflows utilize Network as Code (NaC) to push configuration changes into your network with all the embeded benefits of validation that Network as Code provides. While providing different options on how to interface with NaC.

### Generic Operation Method Pattern
**Pattern**: Centralize multi-operation API logic in single generic method; eliminates duplicate payload construction across operation types
**Details**: Create _operation_request(operation_type, data, params) method supporting multiple ops (merge/batch/replace/delete/apply); unified payload building with change_message, apply, source params; client methods delegate to generic handler
**Benefits**: DRY principle; 30→18 lines (VRF), 36→24 lines (Network); single source of truth for operation logic; easier maintenance

### Form-First, Table-Second UI Layout Pattern
**Pattern**: Prioritize data entry forms above data display tables in CRUD action pages; enhances user workflow by keeping creation/edit forms prominently visible while maintaining visibility of existing data below
**Details**: Place form for data entry/editing at top of page with primary focus; display table of existing records below form with refresh capability; consistent layout across all action pages (VRFs, Networks, Interfaces, etc.)
**Benefits**: Improves UX by prioritizing workflow (data entry) over data review; reduces scrolling for primary actions; maintains consistent UI patterns; keeps creation context immediately visible

**Use**: Multi-layer APIs; API gateways; wrapper APIs
